topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: I keep replaying those days in my head, the times we laughed, the secrets we shared, thinking maybe it's just a misunderstanding. I remember everything so vividly, every joke, every game, every promise. But when I called, hoping for that same warmth, the response was so distant. It's like reaching for a light switch in a room that's suddenly much darker. I wonder if it's just a mistake, if maybe they're just playing a strange game. I keep thinking about how to bring back those memories, how to reconnect, but every idea feels a bit more out of reach.
